Jensen Huang Vera Rubin compute tray no cables liquid cooled

hook: NVIDIA made a computer which has *no cables and wires*, and is fully liquid cooled
caption:
NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang says its next-generation Vera Rubin platform is now in full production, with a new design that makes its hardware far easier to build.
A compute tray that took nearly two hours to assemble on Grace Blackwell now takes around five minutes on Vera Rubin, cutting assembly time by up to 20x.
NVIDIA achieved this by replacing complex internal cables with a redesigned circuit board, while removing fans and relying on liquid cooling.
The simpler design also makes servicing easier and could help NVIDIA manufacture and deploy AI systems faster as data centers race to expand capacity.
